did.abstract: Donna Santisi was a photographer and documentarian of the Los Angeles punk scene from 1976-1980. This collection primarily comprises Los Angeles music photography and ephemera created to document the Los Angeles music scene from 1973-2017, in particular the Los Angeles punk rock scene between 1976-1980.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Processed by CFPRT scholar Laila Jaffer with assistance from Kelly Besser, Doug Johnson, and CFPRT assistant Kate Ahn, 2025. Nicole Alvarado and Consuela Metzger of UCLA Library Preservation and Conservation Department provided expert care for the Posters and Memorabilia series. Digital materials processed by CFPRT Born Digital Processing Scholar Estefanía Gallo-Gonzalez with assistance from Azad Namazie.

Digital materials were received on one hard drive, two CDs, and two flash drives. All digital file naming, organization and arrangement created by Donna Santisi was retained. The files were logically transferred using TeraCopy Pro then were ultimately processed and packaged for long-term preservation in Archivematica version 1.18.0. The .JPG files were normalized to .TIFF files for preservation.

Collections are processed to a variety of levels depending on the work necessary to make them usable, their perceived user interest and research value, availability of staff and resources, and competing priorities. Library Special Collections provides a standard level of preservation and access for all collections and, when time and resources permit, conducts more intensive processing. These materials have been arranged and described according to national and local standards and best practices.

We are committed to providing ethical, inclusive, and anti-racist description of the materials we steward, and to remediating existing description of our materials that contains language that may be offensive or cause harm. We invite you to submit feedback about how our collections are described, and how they could be described more accurately, by filling out the form located on our website: Report Problematic Content and Description in UCLA's Library Collections and Archives.

bioghist.head: Biographical History
bioghist.p: Donna Santisi is an internationally published photographer who has been exploring the photographic side of the music scene since the early 1970s. Her work has endured the changing faces of music and her imagery offers privileged glimpses of some of the most influential artists in rock and roll history. In 1978 Donna published her sought after book, Ask The Angels, which features musicians that were pivotal to the L.A. music scene. (Bio adapted from Donna Santisi's website)

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The bulk of this collection comprises negatives, contact sheets, prints, and slides of Donna Santisi's photographic work. The majority of the ephemera includes publications which published Santisi's photographs. In addition to these and other publications Santisi collected, the collection includes ephemera she saved such as ticket stubs to shows, backstage passes, flyers, correspondence, buttons, posters, invoices, scrapbooks, a Runaways scarf, and two audiocassettes.

The primary contents of this collection are photographs and punk rock ephemera created to document the Los Angeles punk scene between 1975 and 1980, but the collection contains Donna Santisi's photographic work through the 2010s. The bulk of the materials were created between 1975-1995.

The digital materials consist of digitized photographs created by Santisi, Santisi's personal photographs and videos, Lexar Data Shield software and user guides, and a spreadsheet with information about photographs and ephemera. These files were created by Santisi between 2008-2024. The majority of the digital files are scans of photographs in the .JPG or .TIFF file formats with one .NUMBERS file, two .PDF files, and one .EXE file. The materials document headshots, award ceremonies, concerts, and other music‑industry events featuring a wide range of performers, including Al Green, Prince, Queen Latifah, and Tracy Chapman. The files reflect Santisi's professional work as a music photographer and her documentation of artists across genres and venues. The photographs are organized in folders by artists' first names, following the creator's original arrangement.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p:
This collection has been arranged in the following series:
Series 1: Photographic materials, 1971-2017
Series 2: Ephemera, 1965-2001
Subseries 2.1: Magazines and newspapers, 1967-2000
Subseries 2.2: Music and performance materials, 1965-1993
Subseries 2.3: Patti Smith memorabilia, 1972-2001
Subseries 2.4: Correspondence, 1972-1999
Subseries 2.5: Posters, 1967-1995
Subseries 2.6: Memorabilia, 1967-1980

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Contains ephemera related to musicians and events that Santisi photographed, such as Janis Joplin and Joan Jett, including photos, press materials, notes to and from Santisi, and sheet music. Additionally features event flyers, many using Santisi's photography, advertising shows for bands like The Heaters, Backstage Pass, The Clique, The Furys, The Zippers, Siouxsie and the Banshees, and more at venues such as Hong Kong Cafe, The Starwood, Whisky A Go Go, The Troubadour, and Cuckoo's Nest.

phystech.head: Physical Characteristics and Technical Requirements
phystech.p: CONTAINS UNPROCESSED AUDIO MATERIALS: Audio materials are not currently available for access and will require further processing and assessment. If you have questions about this material please email AskLSC@library.ucla.edu. Contains one unprocessed audiocassette and two unprocessed open reel audiotapes.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Contains ephemera related to musicians and events that Santisi photographed, such as the Runaways, Melissa Etheridge, and Michelle Malone, including photos, press materials, clippings, event programs, and merchandise. Also includes the first half of a scrapbook with materials related to the Runaways, such as ticket stubs and photos.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Contains the second half of a scrapbook with materials related to the Runaways, such as ticket stubs and photos. Also includes ephemera related to musicians and events that Santisi photographed, including photos, press materials, press passes, and ticket stubs. Includes CD of the album "Everything Else" by Sally Landers and Michelle Mangione.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Contains copies of periodicals collected by Santisi featuring articles on Patti Smith, from publications such as Playgirl, Penthouse, Creem, Viva, Rock Scene, Spin, and more. Additionally contains clippings of articles on the artist.

did.unittitle: Patti Smith clippings and fan materials

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Contains clippings of photographs and articles of Patti Smith collected by Santisi, fan-produced materials from the Patti Smith Fan Club, zines, press kits and promotional materials, flyers, correspondence, and an audiocassette of Patti Smith's performance recordings. Within the correspondence is a letter from Patti Smith's mother thanking Santisi for taking photographs that were included in the scrapbooks made by Smith's mother while the artist was on tour.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Contains correspondence between Santisi and various professional contacts and organizations related to her photography career, as well as business cards and invoices. The materials detail the processes behind getting published as an independent photographer and chart the path of Santisi's photography career.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Contains the degree awarded to Santisi by Rider College and a letter informing Santisi of her inclusion on the Dean's List, as well as a high school reunion booklet from St. Peter's High School, from which she graduated in 1967.
